Overview

Xuzhou is a city in Jiangsu with a population of 9,083,000. A historic city in northern Jiangsu, a key transportation hub known for its Han dynasty heritage and coal mining history. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
